name: Hotel Services, Inc.
imageAlt: Hotel Services, Inc. website shown on a desktop display
body: We teamed up with Hotel Services, Inc., California’s go-to destination for hotel liquidation, FF&E services, and premium used furniture, to transform their outdated website into a modern, user-friendly platform. With a stunning new showroom in Anaheim and a nationwide client base, they needed a site that could match their scale and service quality — and now they have it.

The new site features a clean, easy-to-navigate layout with large, impactful imagery showcasing their inventory, services, and success stories. Visitors can now explore products, get estimates, and sign up for real-time inventory updates with ease.

Designed for both English and Spanish-speaking audiences, and optimized for SEO and lead generation, the site is now a true digital extension of the top-tier service they’ve delivered for decades. With better branding, improved UX, and seamless mobile responsiveness, Hotel Services, Inc. is ready to welcome the next wave of clients with confidence.
